### What to do (Task 9 GREEN — strategy (b) per session-24 pin)

In `src/lib/library/hydrateLibrary.ts`, replace the editions placeholder block (the lines after the works mapping where `editionsByWork` is initialized as empty) with N parallel per-work fetches:

```ts
	// 3. Query editions per work (strategy b — Pérotin probe 6a248b9)
	const edPromises = works.map((w) =>
		fetch(
			`${base}/entity?_type.string=edition&_parent.reference=${w.id}&props=name,year,publisher,license_note&limit=50`,
			{ headers },
		)
			.then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : { entities: [] }))
			.then((body: { entities?: any[] }) => ({ workId: w.id, raws: body.entities ?? [] })),
	);
	const edResults = await Promise.all(edPromises);
	const editionsByWork = new Map<string, EntuEdition[]>();
	edResults.forEach(({ workId, raws }) => {
		editionsByWork.set(
			workId,
			raws.map((e): EntuEdition => ({
				id: e._id,
				workId,
				label: e.name?.[0]?.string ?? '',
				year: e.year?.[0]?.number,
				publisher: e.publisher?.[0]?.string,
				isbn: e.license_note?.[0]?.string,  // license_note → isbn per Pérotin secondary finding
			})),
		);
	});

	return { status: 'ready', library, works, editionsByWork };
```

**Remove** the temporary `editionsByWork` placeholder + the early empty-map seed from Task 8. The final block above replaces them.

### Key shape adjustments from plan's strategy-(b) sample
- URL `props=` requests `license_note` (not `isbn`) — matches Pérotin's discovery that real entities lack `isbn`
- `isbn: e.license_note?.[0]?.string` — sources type field from the real property
- `limit=50` per the spec pin (editions-per-work upper bound; bumpable later)

[2026-05-24 21:42] Good catch. Confirmed it's NOT a spec defect — it's a Paraglide / Inlang compilation bug:

The compiled output at `src/lib/paraglide/messages.js` shows:
```js
export const library_master_count = (params) => `${params['n, plural, one {1 work']} other ${params['{n']} works}}`
```

Paraglide's `@inlang/plugin-message-format` doesn't parse ICU plural syntax — it treats the whole `{n, plural, ...}` block as a single placeholder name with weird literal escaping. So the bug renders garbage in PRODUCTION too, not just tests.

Route is: **Comenius fixes the i18n keys (all 4 locales)**, not Tallis. Holding your `LibraryMaster.svelte` uncommitted in WT. Sit tight; dispatching Comenius now.

Result: wood-grain doesn't render behind the master-detail; it sits on the default body background. PO surface-stopped on visual check at mvox.eu. ### Fix Move the entire `{#if $librarySectionStore.status === 'loading'} ... {/if}` block INSIDE the DeskSurface wrapper, after the task-stacks grid `` (line 212). The target location is between the closing `` of the task-stacks grid and the closing `` of the outer `flex flex-col` wrapper. Suggested wrapping for spacing/structure (so the master-detail has appropriate breathing room from the task stacks above): ```svelte
{#if $librarySectionStore.status === 'loading'}
…loading library…
{:else if $librarySectionStore.status === 'empty'} {:else if $librarySectionStore.status === 'ready'} {:else if $librarySectionStore.status === 'error'}
Something went wrong loading the library.
{/if}
``` ### Why the original placement was wrong Plan Task 18 said "Replace the catalog-strip section near the bottom of the template..." — the catalog strip lived INSIDE DeskSurface. The replacement should have stayed in the same slot.
